Product tasks are the UI wave's phases 0 and 1 (docs/art/ui-quality/report.md section 3.3: steps 1-4 in phase 0; steps 4-7, AD's board 1 and flow review in phase 1). Phase 1 started on 4 November 2026 by the owner's order 3 (CLAUDE.md), with D13's answer (c): at most three UI builders at once, icon batches 3 and 4 deferred (not filed). SV's are the owner's server decisions (docs/decisions/owner-decisions.md, 'Build tasks'); BT's are the protocol's build tasks. O2 and O3 were the owner's reviews; since 30 October 2026 AD does them as ordinary tasks (report.md section 3.4), so no task waits for the owner. The order of 'tasks' is priority. building_cap is three UI builders (D-05, D13 (c)) plus SV, approved by the owner on 30 October 2026. Phase 2 started on 12 November 2026 (lead cycle 70): P1-AD-board-1d let board 1 stand and phase 1's other exit criteria hold (report.md section 3.2); its first tasks are the flow findings (S1, S2) and board 1's note G (AIA-2), within the same cap of three. Since 12 November 2026, about 20:00Z, the cap is four UI builders by the owner's order (CLAUDE.md order 3; three while the seven-day bar reads allowed_warning). Phase 3 (polish and harden, report.md step 12) started on 17 November 2026 (lead cycle 118) under M49: every phase 2 task was merged by 06:55Z, the exit review ran in cycle 118 (boards 3, 4 and 5 stand, board 2 waits on the deferred icon batch 4 by D13 (c), the exceptions queue is empty, every screen passes the gate but result at 200% pt_BR, Hierarchy, which P3-S1-result-7 takes), and the first blind audit (O6) is carried into phase 3 as P3-AD-audit-1. Phase 3 draws from the 20-hour reserve; it exits when no board has an open objection, the second blind audit is done and the wave board (O7) stands. The bug-fix wave started on 21 November 2026 by the owner's order (CLAUDE.md order 1, entry of 21 November): the UI is paused (P3-S3-settings-4, P4-S1-heist-vault and P4-S2-home-purse parked with their work on their branches; the BT track stays parked) while up to four fix builders, FX1 to FX4 within the cap of four, fix the 60 confirmed defects of docs/security/bug-report-2026-11.md, highs first, each with a test that fails before the fix, then recheck the four unproven candidates (7, 21, 23, 34) and audit the code the report did not read (findings in docs/security/audit-2026-11/, from which the lead files fix tasks). The FX tasks' phase is 'fix'; the UI resumes at phase 3 when every FX task is merged.
